case.name: Malluch

A.name: Malluch
A.notes: named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:4)

kjv.NEH 12:14: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

B.name: Malluch
B.line: Priest who returned with Zerubbabel; his house head later called Melicu/Jonathan

kjv.NEH 12:14: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

first_reader_said: NEH 12:2: Both records are the priest Malluch whose house (Melicu/Malluchi) Jonathan headed, which A records through ancestor-of jonathan-11.

why: NEH 12:2 places Malluch among the priests who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua (NEH 12:1), while NEH 10:4 names a covenant signer in Nehemiah’s much later generation. NEH 12:14 identifies Jonathan as head of the earlier Malluch/Melicu priestly house in Joiakim’s days; it does not identify the later signer with that house’s founder. A’s references to NEH 12:2 and NEH 12:14 therefore belong to B.
